claims.sectionKey: Expresión regional de você como sujeto
claims.summary: The pronoun você can present phonetic realizations and regional variants such as ôcê or cê, depending on the region, speech speed, style, and local identity.

The full form você is common in many contexts, cê appears widely in colloquial speech in several regions, and ôcê can be more strongly associated with certain areas or styles. These variants typically maintain third-person concordance: você vai, cê vai, ôcê vai.

The phonetic reduction does not determine the educational level of the speaker. These variants are part of sociolinguistic repertoires and can appear or disappear depending on the communicative situation.

links.notes: The article explicitly states that você can be realized as ôcê or cê, with the choice depending on various factors such as region, speech speed, style, and local identity. This claim is supported by the source MLS-SRC-589A11BEAD5800146B97, which is an institutional webpage from Ciberdúvidas da Língua Portuguesa, a credible source in the field of Portuguese language studies.

The article provides detailed information on the usage of você, cê, and ôcê, including their phonetic realizations and regional variants. This claim is supported by the same source MLS-SRC-589A11BEAD5800146B97, which offers a comprehensive explanation of the topic.

The article clarifies that the phonetic reduction of você does not affect the speaker's educational level and that the variants are part of sociolinguistic repertoires. This claim is supported by the same source MLS-SRC-589A11BEAD5800146B97, which provides context and clarifications on the topic.
